lead: Things a person owns as files, account items or registered tokens: fonts, creative assets, game and platform items, personal media files, domains and NFTs, organised by type, then archetype (typeface, skin line, collection) with file formats and titles kept out of the tree as attributes.

b.v: open file without locks > personalised watermark > locked to an account > licence in a locker
b.w: You own it only if it is not locked; ownership ranks above catalogue size.

b.v: desktop, web, app, server (a fit, not a ladder)
b.w: The same family is licensed separately per use.
Character set decides where it can be used.

b.v: variable font > full static family > few weights
b.w: More weights and widths give more range.
